summary: Very steep kerb, about 21% grade, with homes 13-21 m away.
reasons: Cars park here, no room to level

drivers.seclusion: Bush backs some of the west kerb, but houses sit 15-21 m away on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the west kerb; fits a van but the grade is too steep to sleep on.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; cars park along this kerb.

flags: Mapped gate 18 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the west kerb most of the day; afternoon sun is blocked.

best_section.where: Woodstock Avenue west kerb, lower end by the parked cars
